source.text: A gunman holding hostages in a Sydney cafe is said to be demanding an #ISIS flag http://t.co/39zCkBTOvF #sydneysiege http://t.co/Z8QH4xssOc

selection_rule: Only comments with an explicit stance toward the source tweet's ISIS/terrorism framing were retained. support = accepts, repeats, or extends the claim that the siege is tied to ISIS, Islamist terrorism, jihadism, or related extremist networks. oppose = rejects the ISIS-flag report, criticizes CNN/mainstream-media framing as wrong or false-flag propaganda, or explicitly separates the gunman/flag from ISIS or terrorism.
note: Selected 30 clear comments with a balanced 15 support and 15 oppose split; ambiguous sympathy, generic calls for violence, unrelated gun-control/police comments, and simple non-evaluative retweets were excluded where possible.
